32nd Meeting

OpenChain KWG Regular Meeting at Hyundai AutoEver

Open source compliance practitioners gather to share cases and expand their professional network. The detailed program will be added to this page as soon as it is confirmed.

Date 2026-12-08 (Tue) 14:00–17:00 Venue Hyundai AutoEver · Samseong-dong, Gangnam-gu, Seoul

Registration and the detailed program are announced via the OpenChain KWG mailing list. Subscribe to receive the sign-up link.
